name: extras
description: More ElevenLabs sounds you turn on, or ask for

sounds.name: typing
sounds.prompt: Soft, clean laptop keyboard typing: a short, steady run of light key presses, close and dry, no music, quiet enough to sit under calm speech.

sounds.name: message-ping
sounds.prompt: A soft, short, friendly message notification ping, clean and modern, no music, quiet enough to sit under calm speech.

sounds.name: camera-shutter
sounds.prompt: A single crisp camera shutter click, close and clean, no music.

sounds.name: applause
sounds.prompt: A small audience applauding warmly for a few seconds, natural room sound, no cheering, no whistles, no music.

sounds.name: laugh
sounds.prompt: A small group of people laughing warmly together for a moment, natural room sound, no music.

sounds.name: cheer
sounds.prompt: A small crowd cheering and whooping happily for a moment, natural room sound, no music.

sounds.name: record-scratch
sounds.prompt: A short vinyl record scratch, a quick comedic stop, no music after it.
